| Harmonic k | Center (fx, fy) | H at the center | H halfway to the next |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | (0.125, 0) | 0 | 1 |
| 2 | (0.250, 0) | 0 | 1 |
| 3 | (0.375, 0) | 0 | 1 |

The base frequency (0.125, 0) with 3 harmonics gives notches at 0.125, 0.25 and 0.375 cycles per pixel and at their mirror points, 6 centers in all, since harmonics on the x axis have no separate mirror points across the axes. Between the harmonics H is close to 1.
